fields.summary: [A11Y] | Souscription | Interactive components | Offers[button "Close"]: Target too small
fields.description:
h1. Flow(s) / Screen(s) / Element(s) in concern
Offers\[button "Close"\]
h1. Actual behavior / Impact
The close button measures 16 by 16 px.
Impact: hard to activate.
h1. Expected behavior
At least 24 by 24 px.
h1. Recommendations
Enlarge the target.
h1. Reference
- Good practice BP1: Each isolated target is at least 24×24 CSS px.
